title: SugarMouse — SugarCraft
description: SugarMouse: Mouse support for terminal UIs — tag rendered output with private-use zone markers (zero-width to the scanner), then hit-test where clicks land.
ogDescription: Mouse support for terminal UIs — tag rendered output with private-use zone markers (zero-width to the scanner; hosts may render PUA glyphs), then hit-test where clicks land.
